description.en-US: Twelve of the addresses Faber gave at the London Oratory in Advent, Lent and the Months of Mary, published in 1859: Kindness (in general, thoughts, words, actions), Death (its aspects, characteristics, the preparation for it, the death precious in the sight of God), Self-Deceit, why so little comes of frequent confession, weariness in welldoing, wounded feelings, confidence the only worship, taking scandal, a taste for reading, the monotony of piety, Heaven and Hell, and the special vocation of every man.
description.pt-BR: Doze das conferências que Faber pronunciou no Oratório de Londres no Advento, na Quaresma e nos Meses de Maria, publicadas em 1859: a bondade (em geral, pensamentos, palavras, ações), a morte (seus aspectos, características, preparação e a morte preciosa aos olhos de Deus), o engano de si mesmo, por que tão pouco resulta da confissão frequente, o cansaço no bem-fazer, os sentimentos feridos, a confiança como único culto, o escândalo recebido, o gosto pela leitura, a monotonia da piedade, Céu e Inferno e a vocação especial de cada homem.

en-US.editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (London: Richardson and Son, 1859)

sources.edition: Spiritual Conferences (London: Thomas Richardson and Son, 1859), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The preface is kept; the dedication, the contents and the index are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Fr. Frederick William Faber died in 1863 and the edition is of 1859, so the text is public domain.

title.en-US: A Death Precious in the Sight of God
The Place and Hour When We Become True

A Taste for Reading Considered as a Help in the Spiritual Life
